We are looking for a highly innovative, data-driven Email Marketing Manager, who’s motivated by the challenge of working with some of the fastest growing e-commerce and digital brands.

You will join a team of email, SMS and retention marketing industry experts to drive client revenue, partner with internal cross functional colleagues to go deeper on understanding our customer needs and insights with a specific focus on deepening retention and building loyalty. You will lead a cross-functional team to build creative strategies in email and SMS campaign development to help our clients grow.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Spain, Mexico, Portugal, and Brazil.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

You’re passionate about e-commerce and digital marketing. You’re immersed in the world of direct-to-consumer growth marketing and love connecting strategy, creativity, and data to drive results.

  • 5+ years of experience in digital marketing, with hands-on retention experience.

  • You immerse yourself in scaling personalized D2C/e-commerce email and SMS programs that build deep customer relationships for clients.

  • You can creatively message the value propositions of any brand’s product catalog to create email and SMS campaigns that customers find to be engaging, informative, and persuasive.

  • You’re passionate about developing creative customer journeys and loyalty programs that drive loyalty and lifetime value.

  • You have experience working in Klaviyo (or a similar ESP’s) including list segmentation, lifecycle drip automations, and triggered events. Additionally, you have knowledge of Shopify and their tech stack options such as Privy, JustUno, Yotpo, Octane AI etc.

  • You have developed SMS and loyalty programming strategies and have experience working with SMS platforms such as Attentive, PostScript, SMSBump, or Klaviyo.

  • You're used to working in a fast paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.

  • You love making data driven decisions and excel at turning analytics into actionable SMS and email strategies that drive client revenue.

  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.

  • You have experience developing and executing customer loyalty programs that enhance LTV.

  • You've had at least one direct report before and exceptional leadership skills working with cross-functional teams.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

A Day in the Life:

  • Serve as the primary retention lead for select clients, working to develop best-in-class retention strategies. On a bi-weekly basis, you will lead meetings with clients to discuss current and future initiatives.

  • Report on strategic KPIs for clients, creating insights and actionable recommendations to grow client retention engagement and revenue.

  • Develop strategic campaign calendars and prioritize projects and initiatives designed to scale your clients’ email, SMS, loyalty and subscription programs.

  • Project manage and delegate campaign briefs to your team, consisting of both retention specialists and designers.

  • Review all client briefs and designs for approval before they are sent to the client to ensure campaign quality and accuracy.

  • Assign segmentation and QA email and SMS campaigns ensuring flawless delivery to customer audiences.

  • Execute on automation/flow logic set-up, pop-up builds, and app integrations.

  • Coordinate cross-departmentally with the Growth, Digital, and Marketplaces teams to develop cohesive campaigns that drive client growth.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

  • Experiência com criação e desenvolvimento de produtos.

No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta we create owners and make private markets liquid.

We live in a world where some people live on the equity stack and enjoy exponential wealth growth and preferential tax treatment; others live on the debt stack and may work their entire lives for a company and retire only with the cash they’ve managed to save from their paychecks. Our contribution to solving the wealth inequality problem is moving people from the debt stack (payroll) to the equity stack. By making it as easy to issue equity to employees as it is to put them on payroll, we can create more owners.

At Carta, we are helpful, transparent, fair, and kind. We are relentless executors, unconventional thinkers, and masters of our craft.

To learn more, here is what one of our investors wrote about leading our Series F.

The Problems You’ll Solve

As an Implementations Project Manager, you will focus efforts on supporting new Investor Services customers in their journey into Carta services. From sale close, to implementation, and continued customer success, the ideal Implementations Project Manager will exhibit excellent communication skills, a high degree of problem‑solving, velocity, embracing change and will constantly seek ways to better their process to provide customers with a world‑class on‑boarding experience.

title: Field Service Technician
description:
Company Overview


If a culture of excellence, innovation and ownership is what you’re searching for, consider putting your experience in motion at Flowserve. As an individual contributor, or as a leader of people, your enterprise mindset will ensure Flowserve’s position as the global standard in comprehensive flow control solutions. Here, your opportunity for professional development and industry leading rewards will be supported by our foundational commitments to the values of people first, integrity and safety. Thinking beyond opportunity and reward, at Flowserve, we are inspired by working together to create extraordinary flow control solutions to make the world better for everyone!


Role Summary


The Field Service Technician installs, commissions, monitors, diagnoses and repairs pumps, mechanical seals and other Flowserve equipment in various industries such as oil and gas, petrochemical, steel, mining, sanitation, etc., depending on our customers' area of operation. The FST offers real‑time technical support at customers' plants and provides recommendations for repairs, upgrades and replacements of parts and equipment. The FST is actively engaged in solving problems and implementing solutions at customer sites, providing world‑class service and creating lasting competitive advantage.


Responsibilities



  • Perform direct, in‑person service calls in response to customer requests.

  • Assess mechanical problems and take action to resolve them promptly.

  • Work side‑by‑side with customer personnel and lead work teams as required.

  • Supervise the complete repair cycle: disassembly, cleaning, inspection, repair and assembly.

  • Ensure that equipment is installed successfully and on schedule.

  • Check equipment before commissioning and start‑up and evaluate performance during and after start‑up.

  • Monitor the maintenance and performance of Flowserve equipment.

  • Guide customers on proper procedures for operating and maintaining Flowserve products.

  • Collaborate effectively with Flowserve support organizations, including repair centers, customer service and sales engineering.

  • Maintain and submit organized and accurate records, including daily reports, jobs quoted, jobs performed, and time and materials charged.

  • Other duties as assigned.


Requirements



  • Mechanical Technician with active CFT.

  • Experience as a Field Service Technician in a refinery industry.

  • Knowledge of industrial applications and operations of pumps, valves, seals, actuators and mechanical equipment.

  • Experience in installing mechanical equipment.

  • Experience in repairing pump equipment, installing mechanical seals, changing seal faces, gaskets, rings, etc.

  • Knowledge of mechanical adjustment by backlash and interference.

  • Knowledge of metrology and the use of measuring instruments such as pachymeters, external and internal micrometers, tubular micrometers, dial gauges and dial gauges.

  • Proven ability to read and correctly interpret mechanical technical drawings, cutting drawings and dimensional drawings of equipment.

  • Good Outlook, Word and Excel skills.

  • Intermediate English.

  • An active driver's license with a good driving record is essential for the job.

  • Willingness to travel and ship, including globally, for long periods.

  • Willingness to work overtime as required to minimize impact on customers.

  • Proven ability to correctly read and interpret mechanical technical drawings, cutting drawings and dimensional drawings of equipment.


Desirable Skills



  • Advanced English and/or intermediate Spanish desirable.

  • Professional certifications in this area.


About Flowserve


Flowserve is a world‑leading manufacturer and aftermarket service provider of comprehensive flow control systems. Join a company whose people are committed to building a more sustainable future to make the world better for everyone. With 16,000+ employees in 50+ countries, we combine our global reach with local presence. Our team challenges itself to approach each situation with ingenuity and creativity to help provide our customers with the most innovative flow control products and services. We support 10,000+ customers worldwide, creating products to meet the needs of our customers who are supplying energy, fresh water, pharmaceuticals and other essentials to consumers, businesses and governments globally. We invite you to put your talents and career in motion at Flowserve.

Swapcard is the leading AI‑powered event platform designed to drive revenue growth and foster meaningful connections at in‑person and hybrid events.   • Hands‑on experience implementing ETL.Experience working with Python.
  • Experience working with a workflow orchestrator (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, Kestra, etc.).
  • At least 4 years of experience with a cloud data warehouse.
  • Fluency in English.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with AWS (e.g., Redshift).
  • Experience with Dagster.
  • Experience with data visualisation tools (e.g., Tableau).
  • Knowledge in infra toolchain (e.g., Docker, Terraform, Helm).

Interview process

  • Screening interview with a recruiter from our people team.
  • A remote exercise to demonstrate and assess your skills.
  • Manager review with your future reporting manager.
  • Leadership review with one of our department leaders.
  • Reference check conducted by our people team.
  • Offer.

Values

  • Curious: We ask questions, try new things and take risks.
  • Value‑Driven: We focus on making each decision count by prioritising outcomes that create meaningful value.
  • Human: We foster empathy, openness, and diversity to create a caring and collaborative community.
  • Resilient: We embrace challenges with optimism, creativity, and adaptability.
  • Ownership: We take responsibility and are accountable for our actions, driving success through initiative, trust, and accountability.

Benefits & Reasons To Join Swapcard

  • International team with 40+ nationalities.
  • Remote‑first policy with headquarters in Paris.
  • Thriving startup with career growth opportunities.
  • Open‑minded culture that appreciates differences.
  • Feedback‑driven, supportive & curious team with a DIY mindset.
  • Generous paid time off to ensure you have time for what matters most.
  • Remote perks designed to optimise your working experience.
  • In‑person social gatherings to celebrate our achievements.

Na Supercomm , somos mais do que uma empresa de tecnologia; somos arquitetos de soluções que simplificam o mundo e impulsionam o futuro. Se você busca um lugar para crescer, inovar e ser valorizado, venha construir o futuro da tecnologia conosco!

Sua capacidade de identificar oportunidades e navegar por desafioscom Resolução de Problemas será crucial. Se você tem Espírito Empreendedor e adora ver processos otimizados este é o seu lugar!

Responsabilidades e Desafios: O que você vai fazer?

  • Acompanhar diariamente o time de vendas, garantindo suporte direto aos vendedores em todas as etapas do ciclo comercial, desde a geração da oportunidade até o fechamento;
  • Conduzir a cadência e a tática comercial, apoiando o time na priorização de oportunidades, montagem de estratégias de negociação e definição de ações de curto prazo;
  • Monitorar métricas de conversão e indicadores individuais de desempenho, fornecendo visibilidade sobre resultados e oportunidades de melhoria para o time e a liderança;

  • Apoiar o Diretor Comercial na análise de resultados e na elaboração de relatórios;
  • Atuar com postura negocial ativa, apoiando discussões e negociações com diferentes perfis de vendedores, gerindo situações de conflito e divergências comerciais de forma madura e construtiva, buscando soluções que preservem relacionamentos e resultados;
  • Promover a melhoria contínua dos processos comerciais, contribuindo com sugestões e ajustes que aumentem a eficiência do time de vendas e a qualidade das entregas;
  • Interação com a equipe de importação para análise e disponibilidade de estoque, atendimento de backlog e suporte nas informações de S&OP;
  • Interação com a equipe de marketing, para análise (qualitativa e quantitativa) dos leads e acompanhamento e sugestões de ações comerciais.

Requisitos e Qualificações: Quem nós procuramos?

  • Superior completo em Engenharia, Administração ou Economia ;
  • Inglês Intermediário/Avançado
  • Experiência sólida em rotinas comerciais e de suporte à força de vendas, com forte capacidade analítica e domínio de matemática comercial.
  • Conhecimento avançado de Excel | Google Sheets e ferramentas de análise comercial;
  • Vivência com negociação, elaboração de propostas e acompanhamento de oportunidades;
  • Conhecimento prático em gestão de funil de vendas, métricas de conversão e indicadores de desempenho individual;
  • Experiência com Salesforce, incluindo atualização de pipeline e geração de relatórios;
  • Organização, priorização e trabalho sob pressão, lidando com múltiplas demandas simultâneas;
  • Habilidade para comunicar-se com clareza, lidar com diferentes perfis de público e conduzir interações construtivas mesmo em situações de conflito;
  • Perfil colaborativo, com energia, autonomia e comprometimento com metas e resultados da equipe.
  • Experiência em relatórios e apresentações para Diretoria e níveis executivos (C-Level).
  • Conhecimento do mercado de Telecom ou provedores de Internet (ISPs).

O Que Oferecemos: Seu crescimento conosco

Na Celeti, investimos em nosso time porque sabemos que o seu sucesso é o nosso sucesso. Oferecemos um ambiente que estimula o Crescimento e a Valorização , com:

  • Pacote de benefícios abrangente: Salário competitivo, SulAmérica Saúde e Dental, Icatu Seguros, Swile (TotalPass) e PLR.
  • Desenvolvimento contínuo: Oportunidades de crescimento e plano de desenvolvimento individual (PDI), com treinamentos e capacitações internas alinhados às suas metas.
  • Cultura de inovação: Atue em um ambiente que respira Atitude Digital e Velocidade , com desafios constantes que promovem o seu Espírito Empreendedor .
  • Ambiente colaborativo: Faça parte de um time que pratica o Respeito e a Colaboração , onde suas ideias são valorizadas.
  • Programas exclusivos: Participe dos nossos programas internos como #SuperInfluencers e #SuperIndicações , fortalecendo nossa cultura e o engajamento.

Venja Fazer a Diferença!

Se você se identifica com a nossa cultura, possui as qualificações necessárias e está pronto(a) para liderar projetos que impactam diretamente o nosso crescimento e a nossa visão de futuro, candidate-se agora!

Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você e sua paixão por projetos que transformam.

Em 13 anos de existência, a Supercomm já se solidificou no setor de tecnologia, oferecendo soluções práticas, acessíveis e de alta qualidade em diferentes segmentos do mercado.

Nossa empresa, valoriza o trabalho em equipe, a inovação e o compromisso com a excelência. Se você busca um ambiente de trabalho estimulante, com oportunidades de aprendizado contínuo e projetos desafiadores, venha fazer parte do nosso #SUPERTIME!

Dentro da diretoria de Finanças, Jurídico e Infraestrutura, a Fábrica de Cenários é a área responsável pela construção e entrega dos cenários que dão vida às produções de entretenimento, dramaturgia e eventos do Grupo Globo.

Reúne profissionais das mais diversas disciplinas — carpintaria, serralheria, pintura, acabamentos e gestão técnica — que transformam projetos criativos em estruturas físicas com excelência técnica e artística.

Nosso desafio é equilibrar inovação, qualidade e velocidade de produção, em um ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e em constante evolução, que integra arte, engenharia e tecnologia.

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Apoiar tecnicamente a execução de obras e montagens cenográficas, garantindo o cumprimento dos projetos, cronogramas e padrões de qualidade estabelecidos;
  • Realizar medições, levantamentos e controle de execução das etapas construtivas (carpintaria, serralheria, pintura, acabamento, elétrica, etc.);
  • Realizar leitura de projetos, cortes e detalhamentos técnicos em projetos, assegurando a compatibilização entre os projetos de arquitetura, cenografia e infraestrutura;
  • Apoiar o time de orçamentos e suprimentos com informações técnicas e quantitativos de materiais;
  • Acompanhar fornecedores e prestadores de serviços durante as etapas de produção e montagem, garantindo conformidade técnica e segurança;
  • Contribuir para o controle de qualidade e atualização de padrões técnicos e construtivos da Fábrica;
  • Apoiar a implementação de boas práticas de Lean Construction e melhoria contínua nos processos produtivos.

Do que você precisa:

  • Formação técnica completa em Edificações;
  • Experiência prévia em obras civis, cenográficas ou de estruturas temporárias;
  • Domínio com Projetos (leitura, interpretação e elaboração de plantas);
  • Conhecimento básico em medições, orçamentos e acompanhamento de obras;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial na Fábrica de Cenários e eventuais deslocamentos para estúdios e locações externas.
  • Conhecimento em Revit, SketchUp ou softwares 3D voltados à construção e cenografia;
  • Experiência em projetos de televisão, eventos, espetáculos ou produção de cenários;
  • Conhecimento em Lean Construction e metodologias de melhoria contínua;
  • Experiência em acompanhamento de equipes multidisciplinares e integração de disciplinas;
  • Curso complementa­rio em Segurança do Trabalho ou Gestão de Projetos.

Por que vir para Globo:

Vem e vamos criar histórias e tecnologias juntos. Na Globo, o encontro de histórias com tecnologia move um time diverso e apaixonado por inovação. A gente tem a chance de aproximar os brasileiros, criando novas formas de se conectar com eles. Aqui, cada um faz a transformação acontecer.

title: Campaign Performance and QA Analyst
description:
Join to apply for the Campaign Performance and QA Analyst role at Launch Potato .

WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is a profitable digital media company that reaches over 30M+ monthly visitors through brands such as FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. As The Discovery and Conversion Company, our mission is to connect consumers with the world’s leading brands through data-driven content and technology. Headquartered in South Florida with a remote-first team spanning over 15 countries, we’ve built a high-growth, high-performance culture where speed, ownership, and measurable impact drive success.

WHY JOIN US?

At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high-performers.

CONTRACT NON-NEGOTIABLES

  • You’re available to work 40 hours per week, Monday - Friday.
  • You’re comfortable working somewhere between 7:00 am to 6:00 pm Eastern Standard Time.
  • You have outstanding communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills and are fluent in English, both written and spoken.
  • You’re highly detail-oriented and reliable.
  • You have excellent administrative skills with the ability to multitask and adapt in a fast-paced remote environment.

BASE SALARY

$1,500 - $2,500 (USD) per month.

YOUR ROLE

You are a detail-oriented, results-driven professional with a passion for maintaining the highest standards of quality and efficiency in operational processes and procedures. Everything goes through QA, so you will be directly responsible for ensuring the success of our campaign launches which connect millions of consumers to our clients monthly! You will also oversee and optimize our operations to ensure they meet and exceed industry standards and organizational objectives. Your unwavering attention to detail and thorough analysis skills will be invaluable in detecting and identifying potential problems within our daily operations. Additionally, you have a proven track record in quality management, process improvement, and possess industry-specific knowledge. Your ability to collaborate and work cross-functionally will enable you to implement effective solutions, making a significant impact on our company's operational excellence.

SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Supporting quality assurance for our financebuzz.com and allaboutcookies.org domains.
  • Maintaining the currently implemented process for building, setting up, and testing tracking URLs across all campaigns and platforms to ensure the highest quality.
  • Reconciling reporting between our internal tracking platforms and external client platforms to ensure proper tracking.
  • Conducting investigations when there is an offer discrepancy or malfunction and finding suitable resolutions.
  • Reviewing platform documentation and internal product setup to find areas of improvement and working with the Operations team to determine next steps to close the gap.
  • Working closely with the Operations team to ensure QA standards are consistently met.

  • Monitoring offer goals to ensure all goals are firing properly after creation.
  • Ensuring QA is successfully implemented with any new process that is rolled out.
  • Quickly becoming a subject matter expert for all QA related processes.

WHAT YOU NEED TO Succeed

  • 2-3 years in operations or quality assurance and expertise in digital media advertising.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Understanding of Postback URL tracking and other performance marketing methods of tracking.
  • Experience with Tune & Yieldspark or similar tracking tools.
  • Experience with Asana or other project management tools.
  • Experience with Looker or similar BI tools like Tableau or PowerBI.
  • Proven abilities to analyze performance reports to improve company efficiency of revenue delivery, product improvement, or general site issues.
  • Proven problem solving abilities and #BetterEveryDay mindset.
  • You are proactive and will search for opportunities, not just being given tasks/tickets.
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills.
  • Fluent in english, both written and verbal.
  • Ability to work East Coast hours consistently.

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

description:
About InPlanet

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scalingEnhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold:to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast. Our company culture blends people-first care andperformance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us. Check out our Culture page here

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure accurate and timely accounting and tax records following Brazilian GAAP and IFRS
  • Support financial consolidation across multiple entities and geographies
  • Drive or support the month-end and year-end closing processes
  • Support the Finance team in corporate finance, strategy, and investor relations
  • Ensure strong internal controls and help mitigate financial and operational risks
  • Coordinate compliance with local and international tax and accounting standards
  • Support treasury operations , including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), and cash flow planning
  • Partner with FP&A to align operational and financial insights
  • Manage with external auditors and advisors during audits and reviews
  • Identify and lead process improvements to make our systems more reliable, efficient, and scalable

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust : You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes
  • Drive : You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field
  • 3-5 years of proven experience in controlling, accounting, or financial reporting roles
  • Deep understanding of Brazilian accounting standards , IFRS , and multi-entity consolidation
  • Strong command of Excel/Google Sheets and experience with financial systems
  • Familiarity with Accounting, Compliance, Treasury (AP & AR) , and FP&A
  • Advanced English communication skills
  • Excellent organizational and project management abilities
  • Collaborative, proactive, curious, and eager to learn
  • Goes above and beyond with a strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Hard-working and hands-on
  • Detail-oriented and analytical, with a problem-solving mindset
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally in a dynamic environment

Bonus Points (but not essential)

  • Experience in a Big 4 or audit firm
  • Experience in financial modeling and valuation
  • Proven track record in building or improving accounting and tax processes in cross-border or fast-growing companies
  • Previous experience in climate tech, sustainability, or international startup settings

Benefits

  • Compensation expectations and our comp philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly.
  • Home Office Budget
  • Fully Remote: (Brazil-based).
  • Personal development budget
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance
  • 40 days annual leave
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.
  • Occasional off-sites in Brazil yay!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity

About the Role

We’re looking for aFinancial & Controlling Analyst / Senior Financial & Controlling Analyst to join our Finance team and strengthen the foundation that supports InPlanet’s growth and impact. You’ll take care ofAccounting & Tax, Financial Reporting, Internal Controls, and Risk Management , ensuring that our operations remain solid, compliant, and ready to scale globally. You\'ll be the kind of person who enjoys both getting things done and thinking strategically - structured, purpose-driven, and comfortable switching between hands-on tasks and higher-level discussions. The Impact you can make
Your work will make a real difference in how we grow — helping InPlanet stay financially healthy, transparent, and ready to make decisions that accelerate our mission of removing CO₂ from the atmosphere. You’ll help build and improve the processes that keep our numbers reliable and our teams confident in their decisions.
Core working relationships
You’ll collaborate closely with:

  • Our Finance Leadership
  • Operations, People, and Science teams
  • External accounting and tax partners

InPlanet Compensation Philosophy

At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate. The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce, we utilize geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach. These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognizing the nuanced demands of each market. The actual base pay for the selected candidate is influenced by factors such as location, skills, experience, training, business requirements, and market dynamics, with the range subject to potential adjustments in alignment with our commitment to fairness and transparency.

We are hiring an Email Marketing Specialist - a sharp, creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, conversion, and customer retention. You’ll partner closely with Retention Managers and designers to develop and deploy high-performing email and SMS campaigns for some of the fastest-growing DTC brands in the world. Darkroom is a career accelerator for marketers who want to operate at the intersection of creativity, commerce, and performance, while mastering the tools and tactics of modern CRM strategy.

Who You Are:

We're looking for an Email Marketing Specialist to join our team! In this role, you will write email and SMS marketing copy, build and deploy email and SMS flows and campaigns, and develop content for our e-commerce, DTC clients.

  • You’re passionate about developing creative email and SMS marketing copy that drives loyalty and lifetime value for e-commerce clients.

  • You’re passionate about marketing, and especially interested in learning and growing in the DTC and e-commerce marketing industry.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!

Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

title: Modélisation de tsunamis déclenchés par des glissements de terrain
description:
Modélisation de tsunamis déclenchés par des glissements de terrain

Niveau de diplôme exigé : Bac + 5 ou équivalent

Fonction : Ingénieur scientifique contractuel

Contexte et atouts du poste

Cadre scientifique: ANR MEGA

Les glissements sous-marins géants km3) sont présents dans les séries sédimentaires Quaternaire des marges continentales passives. Si leurs âges coïncident avec des fluctuations eustatiques, il est encore difficile d’expliquer comment d’aussi grandes ruptures sont générées sur de faibles pentes (<2˚) en l'absence d'un facteur déclenchant tel qu’un séisme. Des hypothèses proposent le rôle de la dissociation des hydrates de gaz et de l’augmentation des pressions interstitielles. Le projet MEGA explorera ces hypothèses grâce aux premières modélisations reliant la stabilité des hydrates de gaz, les variations de pression/température sur le fond marin et la stabilité des pentes. Il s’appuyera sur une comparaison innovante des systèmes du Nil et de l'Amazone, leurs forçages climatiques différant au cours des cycles glaciaires-interglaciaires. En l’absence de cas historiques de méga glissements, MEGA propose de modéliser leurs conséquences en terme de tsunami sur les zones côtières.

L’ objectif est de modéliser et simuler numériquement des tsunamis déclenchés par des glissements sous-marins géants en s'appuyant sur le couplage de deux codes numériques existants: Shaltop pour le glissement de terrain, et Freshkiss3D pour la propagation du tsunami.

La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec des géologues de L'Institut des Sciences de la Terre de Paris (ISTeP ) et des mathématicien·nes de l'équipe projet ANGE inria Paris/LJLL.

Mission confiée

  • Étude de stratégies de couplage numérique entre Shaltop et Freshkiss3D.
  • Simulation de différents scénarios de glissements de terrain géants sur des zones géographiques précises.
  • Déterminer le rôle de la stratification en température de l'océan

La personne recrutée pourra s'appuyer sur l'approche numérique développée lors d'une précédente collaboration (ANR ALBAMAR) et sur les résultats déjà obtenus dans le cadre de ce projet.

Lieux de travail : ISTeP, Sorbonne Université, Paris. De courts séjours chez les partenaires du projet sont susceptibles d'avoir lieu (UMR Géoazur, UMR EPOC, Linnaeus University en Suède,Fluminense Federal University et Université d'état de Rio de Janeiro au Brésil).

Collaboration :
La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec Sara Lafuerza (ISTeP), Nina Aguillon (LJLL/ Inria Paris), Jacques Sainte-Marie (Inria Paris) et Bernard Di Martino (Université de Corse).

Responsabilités :
La personne recrutée a la charge de développer le couplage numérique et prendra des initiatives pour communiquer les résultats obtenus aux partenaires du projet.

Pilotage/Management :
La personne recrutée pourra être amener à former un/une étudiante en thèse à la simulation numérique.

Principales activités

Principales activés:

  • Implémenter des scénarios de réaction de l'océan à un glissement sous-marin géant
  • Déterminer les paramètres pertinents
  • Présenter l’avancée des travaux aux partenaires
  • Proposer des améliorations de stratégie numérique

Activités complémentaires :

  • Participer à l'écriture des rapports
  • Initier à l'utilisation du code les partenaires du projet
  • Restauration subventionnée
  • Transports publics remboursés partiellement
  • Congés: 7 semaines de congés annuels + 10 jours de RTT (base temps plein) + possibilité d'autorisations d'absence exceptionnelle (ex : enfants malades, déménagement)
  • Possibilité de télétravailet aménagement du temps de travail
  • Équipements professionnels à disposition (visioconférence, prêts de matériels informatiques, etc.)
  • Prestations sociales, culturelles et sportives (Association de gestion des œuvres sociales d'Inria)
  • Thème/Domaine : Sciences de la planète, de l'environnement et de l'énergie
    Calcul Scientifique(BAP E)

  • Durée de contrat : 11 mois
  • Date limite pour postuler :

Attention : Les candidatures doivent être déposées en ligne sur le site Inria. Le traitement des candidatures adressées par d'autres canaux n'est pas garanti.

Consignes pour postuler

Sécurité défense :
Ce poste est susceptible d’être affecté dans une zone à régime restrictif (ZRR), telle que définie dans le décret n° relatif à la protection du potentiel scientifique et technique de la nation (PPST). L’autorisation d’accès à une zone est délivrée par le chef d’établissement, après avis ministériel favorable, tel que défini dans l’arrêté du 03 juillet 2012, relatif à la PPST. Un avis ministériel défavorable pour un poste affecté dans une ZRR aurait pour conséquence l’annulation du recrutement.

Politique de recrutement :
Dans le cadre de sa politique diversité, tous les postes Inria sont accessibles aux personnes en situation de handicap.

  • expérience en simulation numérique en mécanique des fluides
  • capacité à travailler en équipe

Inria est l’institut national de recherche dédié aux sciences et technologies du numérique. Il emploie 2600 personnes. Ses 215 équipes-projets agiles, en général communes avec des partenaires académiques, impliquent plus de 3900 scientifiques pour relever les défis du numérique, souvent à l’interface d’autres disciplines. L’institut fait appel à de nombreux talents dans plus d’une quarantaine de métiers différents. 900 personnels d’appui à la recherche et à l’innovation contribuent à faire émerger et grandir des projets scientifiques ou entrepreneuriaux qui impactent le monde. Inria travaille avec de nombreuses entreprises et a accompagné la création de plus de 200 start-up. L'institut s'eﬀorce ainsi de répondre aux enjeux de la transformation numérique de la science, de la société et de l'économie.

title: Payroll Specialist
description:
Overview

Recruitment Supervisor | Professional Psychologist | Talent Acquisition Specialist | Bilingual (EN/ES) | Full-Cycle Hiring Expert in the U.S.

Payroll Process Improvement Specialist (Remote)

Location: World wide (Remote - contractor)

Work schedule: Monday to Friday (8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. EST Time)

Salary: Up to $17.00/hr

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Payroll Process Improvement Specialist to lead the modernization and optimization of our payroll operations. This role will bridge technical expertise with operational payroll knowledge, working closely with our Finance team’s data analyst and payroll staff to streamline workflows, reduce reliance on SQL-based processes, and ensure scalability for future business needs. The ideal candidate will initially partner with our data analyst to implement recommendations from our recent payroll process review, then transition into a key member of the payroll team — with potential to grow into a leadership or management position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Gain a deep understanding of current payroll operations, tools, and workflows.
  • Review and prioritize consultant recommendations for payroll process improvements.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual work, eliminate redundancies, and improve process flexibility.
  • Partner with the Finance team’s data analyst to design and implement automation solutions and reporting enhancements.
  • Work with stakeholders to replace SQL-dependent steps with more user-friendly and maintainable solutions.
  • Document all process changes, configurations, and workflows for ongoing team use.
  • Implement process improvements that make payroll more dynamic and adaptable to changes in regulations, policies, and staffing.
  • Introduce monitoring tools, validation checks, and exception-handling processes to reduce errors.
  • Recommend and implement payroll technology enhancements, integrations, or system upgrades.

Transition to Operational Role

  • Take ownership of the updated payroll process once improvements are implemented.
  • Serve as a payroll subject matter expert within the organization.
  • Potentially lead the payroll function, providing guidance, training, and mentorship to team members.

Qualifications

  • Strong experience with US-based payroll processing, including multi-state payroll compliance and tax regulations.
  • Hands-on experience with Workday payroll and/or OneSource Virtual (OSV) services.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, complex formulas, and data analysis.
  • 3+ years of experience in payroll operations, payroll systems, or payroll process improvement.
  • Strong knowledge of payroll compliance, tax regulations, and reporting requirements.
  • Ability to translate technical/data concepts into business-friendly processes.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose process inefficiencies.
  • Experience with automation tools, low-code/no-code platforms, or business intelligence/reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx).
  • Understanding of SQL and ability to collaborate with technical/data teams.
  • Project management experience, especially in process improvement or systems implementation.

Success in This Role Looks Like

  • Payroll processing becomes faster, more accurate, and less reliant on the Data team.
  • The payroll process can easily adapt to organizational or regulatory changes.
  • Documentation and tools are in place for payroll staff to manage processes independently.
  • The individual is a trusted operational leader and payroll process expert.

  • Associate

  • Full-time
